title: NullReceiver: npm releases retrieving payloads through Ethereum transactions
description: Releases Sonatype identified as malicious in its analysis of a technique that hides the command-and-control address inside an Ethereum transaction: the package reads the recipient of a zero-value transfer and decodes the server address from it, so the address can be rotated on-chain without republishing the package. Each entry is a specific published version, in name@version form.
disclaimer: Third-party-reported, not independently verified per release by Chollima Hunter. These are version-pinned indicators on purpose: for a compromised legitimate package the name identifies the victim project rather than the threat, so a bare package name is not carried here, and the inclusion of a version says only that the cited report describes that release as malicious. Check the cited post before acting on any single entry.

source.title: Six npm Packages Use Ethereum Transactions to Retrieve Malicious Payloads
